question: Which year has the highest average consumer confidence index?
query: SELECT date, consumer_confidence_index FROM finance_economics_dataset WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) IN ( SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) FROM finance_economics_dataset GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) ORDER BY AVG(consumer_confidence_index) DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0 ) LIMIT 50;
answer:
Based on the query results, the highest consumer confidence index recorded in 2007 was 119.0 on January 25th of that year. This represents a significant peak in consumer confidence during this period.

Note: The data only spans from January to February 2007, so while we can identify the highest single value (119.0), there isn't enough historical data available within this specific timeframe to definitively state which overall year had the highest average index.
